messages:
Maya (AE): Fairwind wants a 20m POC next Tue. Scope: streaming invoice ingestion, tool calls for parsing, and strict structured JSON output for downstream accounting. Need a one-pager + Node example and rough cost for ~1M tokens/mo. Also call out EU data residency and SSO notes.
Ethan (SE): I'll draft the one-pager. @Rico can you paste a minimal Node SSE + tool_call example and recommended batch defaults?
Rico (SDK Eng): Minimal Node SSE snippet below. For most POCs SSE is simplest; websocket only if bi-directional low-latency control needed.
Rico (SDK Eng): ```js
const RW = require('@redwood/inference')
const client = new RW({ apiKey: process.env.RW_KEY })
const s = client.stream({ model: 'redwood-chat-1', mode: 'sse' })
s.on('message', m => { try { const obj = JSON.parse(m); console.log(obj) } catch(e) {} })
// tool call envelope: {"type":"tool_call","tool":"invoice_parser","input":{"text":"..."}}
```
Rico (SDK Eng): Defaults: batch_size=8, token_window=512. For p99 <300ms use batch_size=1 + KV cache. Recommend reserved capacity if >200 concurrent streams.
Maya (AE): Can we show a small output schema to demo deterministic mapping?
Rico (SDK Eng): Demo schema: invoice_id (string), date (ISO), total (number), currency (string), vendor{name, vat?}, items[{desc, qty, unit_price}]. I'll add adapter sample to map keys.
Nina (Security): Fairwind requires SAML SSO and EU KMS. For demo we can use ephemeral creds + scoped logs. Legal sign-off before any production PII. Also request: enable log-redaction toggle in staging.
Omar (Solutions): Ballpark pricing for 1M tokens/mo: hosted gen+embeds ~$700/mo. Reserved cluster for steady high throughput adds ~$7k/mo depending on GPU. I'll prepare a slide with tradeoffs.
Maya (AE): Can we have a staging link and ephemeral creds by Monday?
DeployBot: Staging deployed: fairwind-poc-staging at https://staging.fairwind.redwood. Ephemeral creds emailed to maya@fairwind.com (24h).
Ethan (SE): Uploaded one-pager + runbook with snippets to internal runbooks. Will include validation harness and a quick assert test to catch schema drift.
Nina (Security): Uploaded security appendix (SSO/KMS/audit retention).
Omar (Solutions): Pricing slide uploaded.
Maya (AE): Thanks everyone — please thumbs-up when you finish edits so I can send to the customer. :rocket:
Ethan (SE): Done.
Rico (SDK Eng): Done.
